basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer and Animal Crossing enthusiast, I've been on Reddit for nearly a decade, sharing my love for video games and community trading. I'm based in Seattle and work as a software developer. In my free time, I enjoy diving deep into game mechanics and trading strategies. I'm married to a fellow gamer, and we often collaborate on gaming projects. My typical online hours are evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a Computer Science degree and over 10 years in the software development industry, I have a strong foundation in technology and gaming systems. I often self-learn new programming languages and gaming strategies through online courses and community forums.
